title: Quick Aerated Indian Oatmeal Kheer
description: A weeknight Indian dessert made with oatmeal, milk, and cardamom, featuring a smoky element from a grilled spice blend.
instructions: Grill a small pan with 1 tsp of ghee over medium heat until it starts to smoke.
Add the cumin seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they release their aroma.
Grind the cumin seeds into a fine powder using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle.
In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, sugar, ground cardamom, and smoked cumin powder.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the oats and salt to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for another 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and the mixture is creamy.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the water.
Let the kheer cool to room temperature, then cover it and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve the kheer chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cardamom powder if desired.
